summary: Keeps bounded numeric clock and duration notation as literal Markdown text without weakening directive diagnostics.

evidence.sourceGrammar: Only a leaf numeric text-directive node whose complete source token has two or three numeric groups is restored. Trailing groups require exactly two digits in the 00-59 domain and word-adjacent, malformed, four-part, attributed, child-bearing, and alphabetic directive forms remain directives.
evidence.executionCapabilities: The compile-time mdast pass reconstructs the exact source slice before registry lookup. Registered directives and unknown alphabetic names continue through the existing typed interpretation and source-mapped diagnostics.
evidence.confinement: The rule reads only offsets in the already confined and partial-expanded Markdown string. It creates no path, resource, file read, include, or external reference.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Parsing and exact text reconstruction are deterministic local compiler work shared by single-file and directory output. No reader runtime or service is involved.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: The replacement bytes and position come only from the authored source range. There is no clock read, locale inference, random identity, placeholder, entity, or output-format branch.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: The extension adds no browser code, script, style, event, raw HTML, URL, eval, callback, import, or CSP source. Restored nodes use ordinary Markdown text rendering.
evidence.accessibility: Time and duration notation remains ordinary readable text in document flow with no generated control or alternate interaction.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: One bounded scan around a candidate numeric text-directive node inspects only adjacent digits and colons. The pass adds no runtime bytes or work.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No dependency or license is added. The implementation composes the installed remark-directive AST, unist traversal, and project compiler.
evidence.compatibility: Valid existing directives, unknown-name diagnostics, source maps, frontmatter parsing, partials, review targets, both output formats, CLI and ESM contracts retain their behavior. Only the previously failing numeric clock/duration ambiguity changes.
